note: Flagged lines the picker can serve, corrected only where corpus evidence and the voice agree (item 5, 2026-09-15). Voice: review/st-voice.md. Residue: review/st-residue.md.

items.en: Ten pm fog turns every street into a film set.
items.current: Mohodi oa 10pm o fetola seterata se seng le se seng film set.
items.proposed: Mohodi wa 10pm o fetola seterata se seng le se seng film set.

items.en: Washing-line roulette: do you hang, or do you fold?
items.current: Roulette ea ho aneka: o a aneka, kapa oa mena?
items.proposed: Roulette ya ho aneka: o a aneka, kapa wa mena?

items.en: The sun is buffering. Do not refresh the page.
items.current: Letsatsi le a buffera. Se ke oa refresha leqephe.
items.proposed: Letsatsi le a buffera. Se ke wa refresha leqephe.

items.en: Mzansi winter does colour like nobody else. Warmth, though...
items.current: Mariha a Mzansi a etsa 'mala jwalo ka ha ho se motho e mong. Mocheso, leha ho le jwalo...
items.proposed: Mariha a Mzansi a etsa mmala jwalo ka ha ho se motho e mong. Motjheso, leha ho le jwalo...

items.en: Fire lit before noon. We are no longer playing games.
items.current: Mollo o tukile pele ho motšeare. Ha re sa bapala.
items.proposed: Mollo o tukile pele ho motsheare. Ha re sa bapala.

items.en: Trout weather. Lovely for the fish. Character-building for the fisherman.
items.current: Boemo ba trout. Bo monate ho tlhapi. Bo aha botho ho motšoasi oa ditlhapi.
items.proposed: Boemo ba trout. Bo monate ho tlhapi. Bo aha botho ho motshwasi wa ditlhapi.

items.en: Winter night rule: the tongs get shared. The spot next to the fire doesn't.
items.current: Molao oa bosiu ba mariha: tong e a arolelanwa. Sebaka se pel'a mollo ha se arolelanoe.
items.proposed: Molao wa bosiu ba mariha: tong e a arolelanwa. Sebaka se pel'a mollo ha se arolelanwe.

items.en: Post-storm Highveld air should be bottled and sold overseas.
items.current: Moya oa Highveld kamora sefefo o lokela ho kenngwa botlolong o rekisoe ditjhabeng.
items.proposed: Moya wa Highveld kamora sefefo o lokela ho kenngwa botlolong o rekiswe ditjhabeng.

items.en: Joburg winter: jacket in the morning, T-shirt by two, jacket again by four.
items.current: Mariha a Joburg: jase hoseng, T-shirt ka hora ea bobedi, jase hape ka hora ea bone.
items.proposed: Mariha a Joburg: jase hoseng, T-shirt ka hora ya bobedi, jase hape ka hora ya bone.

items.en: By noon this water is bath temperature. Plan accordingly.
items.current: Ka motšeare metsi ana ke mocheso oa ho hlapa. Rera ka mokgwa oo.
items.proposed: Ka motsheare metsi ana ke motjheso wa ho hlapa. Rera ka mokgwa oo.

items.en: Lunch moved outside because inside is hotter than outside. Nobody can explain it.
items.current: Lunch e fallile kantle hobane ka hare ho tjhesa ho feta kantle. Ha ho motho ea ka hlalosang.
items.proposed: Lunch e fallile kantle hobane ka hare ho tjhesa ho feta kantle. Ha ho motho ya ka hlalosang.

items.en: All plans are officially moved to 'when it clears up'. Which is never. Shame.
items.current: Merero eohle e fallisetsoe ho 'ha ho se ho hlaka'. E leng le kgale. Shame.
items.proposed: Merero eohle e fallisetswe ho 'ha ho se ho hlaka'. E leng le kgale. Shame.

items.en: The sky is in its interview suit: grey, neat, giving nothing away.
items.current: Lehodimo le apere suit ea interview: le lerootho, le hlwekile, ha le fane ka letho.
items.proposed: Lehodimo le apere suit ya interview: le lerootho, le hlwekile, ha le fane ka letho.

items.en: The sky's curtains are drawn. Privacy, please.
items.current: Likhethene tsa lehodimo di kwetswe. Privacy, ka kopo.
items.proposed: Dikgaratene tsa lehodimo di kwetswe. Privacy, ka kopo.

items.en: The sky put the stars on silent. They're still up there, promise.
items.current: Lehodimo le behile dinaledi ho silent. Di sa ntsane di le teng hodimo, ke a tšepisa.
items.proposed: Lehodimo le behile dinaledi ho silent. Di sa ntsane di le teng hodimo, ke a tshepisa.

items.en: Dress like an aloe: layers on layers, and refuse to fall over.
items.current: Apara jwalo ka aloe: diaparo holim'a diaparo, 'me o hane ho oa.
items.proposed: Apara jwalo ka aloe: diaparo holim'a diaparo, 'me o hane ho wa.

items.en: Sunglasses and a scarf. It's that kind of day.
items.current: Liborele tsa letsatsi le scarf. Ke letsatsi la mofuta oo.
items.proposed: Diborele tsa letsatsi le scarf. Ke letsatsi la mofuta oo.

items.en: Everything you can hear tonight is one owl with strong opinions.
items.current: Sohle seo o ka se utlwang bosiu bona ke serubisi se le seng se nang le maikutlo a matla.
items.proposed: Sohle seo o ka se utlwang bosiu bona ke morubisi o le mong o nang le maikutlo a matla.

items.en: Small-town quiet: you can actually hear yourself think. Terrifying.
items.current: Kgutso ea toropo e nyane: o ka utlwa mohopolo oa hao. Hwa tšosa.
items.proposed: Kgutso ya toropo e nyane: o ka utlwa mohopolo wa hao. Hwa tshosa.

items.en: Highveld winter flex: laundry dry before the kettle's even done.
items.current: Flex ea mariha ea Highveld: diaparo di omile pele ketlele e qeta.
items.proposed: Flex ya mariha ya Highveld: diaparo di omile pele ketlele e qeta.

items.en: The dams get their drink before you get your coffee. Know your place.
items.current: Matamo a nwa pele o fumana kofi ea hao. Tseba sebaka sa hao.
items.proposed: Matamo a nwa pele o fumana kofi ya hao. Tseba sebaka sa hao.

items.en: The gown is daywear now. We're calling it winter couture.
items.current: Gown ke seaparo sa motšeare jwale. Re e bitsa winter couture.
items.proposed: Gown ke seaparo sa motsheare jwale. Re e bitsa winter couture.

items.en: Free State dusk: the most beautiful ten minutes of the coldest night.
items.current: Ho dikela ha letsatsi Free State: metsotso e leshome e metle ka ho fetisisa ea bosiu bo batang ka ho fetisisa.
items.proposed: Ho dikela ha letsatsi Free State: metsotso e leshome e metle ka ho fetisisa ya bosiu bo batang ka ho fetisisa.

items.en: The sunset is free of charge. So is the head cold.
items.current: Ho dikela ha letsatsi ke ha mahala. Le mokhohlane.
items.proposed: Ho dikela ha letsatsi ke ha mahala. Le mokgohlane.

items.en: Nobody's standing at the coals for the food. We're here for the heat.
items.current: Ha ho motho ea emeng mashaleng bakeng sa dijo. Re teng bakeng sa mocheso.
items.proposed: Ha ho motho ya emeng mashaleng bakeng sa dijo. Re teng bakeng sa motjheso.

items.en: Watermelon isn't dessert. It's first aid.
items.current: Legapu ha se dessert. Ke thuso ea pele.
items.proposed: Lehapu ha se dessert. Ke thuso ya pele.

items.en: The city pulled up its duvet. Leave it alone.
items.current: Toropo e hulile duvet ea eona. E tlohele.
items.proposed: Toropo e hulile duvet ya eona. E tlohele.

items.en: The smell of rain has already RSVP'd.
items.current: Monko oa pula o se o entse RSVP.
items.proposed: Monko wa pula o se o entse RSVP.

items.en: The moon has hung out a do-not-disturb sign.
items.current: Kgwedi e leketlisitse letswao la 'se ke oa nkhathatsa'.
items.proposed: Kgwedi e leketlisitse letswao la 'se ke wa nkgathatsa'.

items.en: Hold your hat. Hold your kid. Just hold on.
items.current: Tšoara katiba ea hao. Tšoara ngwana oa hao. Itšoarelle feela.
items.proposed: Tshwara katiba ya hao. Tshwara ngwana wa hao. Itshwarelle feela.

items.en: Outside: 2 degrees. Inside: 9 degrees and a very good fire. SA homes, hey.
items.current: Kantle: li-degree tse 2. Ka hare: li-degree tse 9 le mollo o hotle haholo. Malapa a SA, hey.
items.proposed: Kantle: di-degree tse 2. Ka hare: di-degree tse 9 le mollo o hotle haholo. Malapa a SA, hey.

items.en: The moon switched the mountains on. The heat, however, stays off.
items.current: Kgwedi e buletse dithaba. Mocheso, leha ho le jwalo, o sala o timile.
items.proposed: Kgwedi e buletse dithaba. Motjheso, leha ho le jwalo, o sala o timile.

items.en: Nobody is driving home in this. That's not laziness, that's science.
items.current: Ha ho ea khannelang hae ho sena. Hoo ha se botswa, ke saense.
items.proposed: Ha ho ya kgannelang hae ho sena. Hoo ha se botswa, ke saense.

items.en: The foghorn is Sea Point's free white-noise machine.
items.current: Foghorn ke motjhini oa mahala oa white noise oa Sea Point.
items.proposed: Foghorn ke motjhini wa mahala wa white noise wa Sea Point.

items.en: The dog doesn't understand where the world went. Same, boy. Same.
items.current: Ntja ha e utloisise hore lefatše le ile hokae. Le rona, boytjie. Le rona.
items.proposed: Ntja ha e utlwisise hore lefatše le ile hokae. Le rona, boytjie. Le rona.

items.en: Four friends, one parcel of chips, zero visibility. Perfect evening.
items.current: Metswalle e mene, pakete e le 'ngoe ea chips, ha ho ho bona. Mantsiboya a phethahetseng.
items.proposed: Metswalle e mene, pakete e le 'ngoe ya chips, ha ho ho bona. Mantsiboya a phethahetseng.

items.en: Thunder at volume ten, the neighbour's dog at eleven.
items.current: Modumo wa seaduma o volume ea leshome, ntja ea moahisane e eleven.
items.proposed: Modumo wa seaduma o volume ya leshome, ntja ya moahisane e eleven.

items.en: Close it, tie it down, surrender.
items.current: E koale, e tlame, o inehele.
items.proposed: E kwale, e tlame, o inehele.

items.en: Somewhere out there people are going for a run right now. Strength to them.
items.current: Kae-kae kantle batho ba ea matha hona jwale. Matla ho bona.
items.proposed: Kae-kae kantle batho ba ya matha hona jwale. Matla ho bona.

items.en: Enjoy the colours. The temperature has already gone to the car.
items.current: Natefeloa ke mebala. Mocheso o se o ile koloing.
items.proposed: Natefelwa ke mebala. Motjheso o se o ile koloing.

items.en: 'One hour at the beach.' History's most confident lie.
items.current: 'Hora e le 'ngoe lebopong.' Leshano le nang le boitšepo ka ho fetisisa historing.
items.proposed: 'Hora e le 'ngoe lebopong.' Leshano le nang le boitshepo ka ho fetisisa historing.

items.en: All meetings moved to the shallow end.
items.current: Dikopano tsohle di fallisetsoe karolong e sa tebang.
items.proposed: Dikopano tsohle di fallisetswe karolong e sa tebang.
